jobs.description:
Our Zurich Office employs more than 40 people across investment, investor relations and further teams. The modern office is situated at Bahnhofstrasse, next to Paradeplatz.

The role
The Intern will directly work with Ardian’s relationship managers for Swiss investors. Typical tasks include:

• Supporting Ardian’s Investor Relations professionals in developing and maintaining client relationships and fundraising activities in Switzerland

• Coordination of fundraising materials within the Ardian group (e.g., product/investment teams)

• Market intelligence and research on Swiss investor landscape

• Organizing and preparing events and other PR activities

• Tailoring materials to produce convincing, top-quality client presentations

• Administrative tasks such as client documentation and management reporting

• Own value-add projects and initiatives

Required skills
The ideal candidate should bring:

• Client-oriented approach and high quality standards

• Keen interest in private markets

• Ability to create convincing content; data visualization skills would be a plus

• Strong multi-tasking and organization skills

• Reliable team player with strong interpersonal competencies

• Good knowledge of MS-Office applications (especially PowerPoint and Excel)

• Excellent skills in German and English (verbal and written); French skills are a strong plus

Profile

• Final-year university student or recent graduate (Bachelor/Master) in Business, Finance or a related field

• Relevant work or internship experience in the financial services industry, consulting, marketing or a related field

• Domiciled and eligible to work in Switzerland

About the Team
As Intern you are an integral part of Ardian’s Investor Relations team in Switzerland, which is responsible for developing and maintaining strong, long-lasting partnerships with Swiss investors. Our Swiss team is part of Ardian’s global Investor Relations team of 160+ professionals. For further information on our team and its activities, please visit: https://www.ardian.com/investor-relations

Other information
Competitive compensation
Lunch voucher

Application process
Using the APPLY link on this page, please submit your application documents in German (cover letter, CV, academic record and relevant additional documents such as certificates, reference letters, etc.), specifying in your cover letter the internship reference ( Ref: IR2027 ) as well as an indication of your earliest availability.

To enhance your recruitment prospects and prepare for potential interviews, please consult our Resource Center . There, you will gain access to a wide range of advice, preparatory materials, and testimonials.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il nostro ufficio di Zurigo impiega più di 40 persone per investimenti, relazioni con gli investitori e altre squadre. L'ufficio moderno si trova a Bahnhofstrasse, vicino a Paradeplatz.

Il ruolo
L'Intern lavorerà direttamente con i responsabili delle relazioni di Ardian per gli investitori svizzeri. I compiti tipici includono:

• Sostenere i professionisti di Ardian Investor Relations nello sviluppo e nel mantenimento delle relazioni con i clienti e delle attività di raccolta fondi in Svizzera

• Coordinamento dei materiali di raccolta fondi all'interno del gruppo Ardian (ad esempio, team di prodotto/investimento)

• Intelligenza di mercato e ricerca sul paesaggio degli investitori svizzeri

• Organizzare e preparare eventi e altre attività di PR

• Materiali su misura per produrre presentazioni client convincenti e di alta qualità

• Compiti amministrativi come documentazione del cliente e reporting di gestione

• Progetti e iniziative

Competenze necessarie
Il candidato ideale dovrebbe portare:

• L'approccio orientato al cliente e gli elevati standard di qualità

• Keen interesse per i mercati privati

• Capacità di creare contenuti convincenti; capacità di visualizzazione dei dati sarebbe un plus

• Forte multi-tasking e capacità organizzative

• Affidabile giocatore di squadra con forti competenze interpersonali

• Buona conoscenza delle applicazioni MS-Office (specialmente PowerPoint ed Excel)

• Competenze eccellenti in tedesco e inglese (verbale e scritto); competenze francesi sono un forte plus

Profilo

• Studente universitario di fine anno o laureato recente (Bachelor/Master) in Business, Finanza o un campo correlato

• Esperienza di lavoro o stage rilevanti nel settore dei servizi finanziari, consulenza, marketing o un settore relativo

• Domiciliato e idoneo a lavorare in Svizzera

Informazioni sulla squadra
Come Intern sei parte integrante del team di Ardian Investor Relations in Svizzera, che è responsabile dello sviluppo e del mantenimento di partnership forti e durature con gli investitori svizzeri. Il nostro team svizzero fa parte del team globale di Investor Relations di Ardian di 160 professionisti. Per ulteriori informazioni sul nostro team e sulle sue attività, visitare: https://www.ardian.com/investor-relations

Altre informazioni
Compensazione competitiva
Buono pranzo

Processo di applicazione
Utilizzando il link APPLY in questa pagina, si prega di inviare i documenti di richiesta in tedesco (lettera di copertura, CV, record accademico e documenti aggiuntivi rilevanti come certificati, lettere di riferimento, ecc), specificando nella vostra lettera di copertura il riferimento di stage ( Ref: IR2027 ) così come un'indicazione della vostra prima disponibilità.

Per migliorare le tue prospettive di reclutamento e prepararti a potenziali interviste, consulta il nostro Centro risorse . Là, si otterrà l'accesso a una vasta gamma di consigli, materiali preparatori e testimonianze.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Unser Büro in Zürich beschäftigt mehr als 40 Mitarbeiter in Investment, Investor Relations und weiteren Teams. Das moderne Büro befindet sich in der Bahnhofstraße, neben dem Paradeplatz.

Die Rolle
The Intern wird direkt mit den Relationship Managern von Ardian für Schweizer Investoren zusammenarbeiten. Typische Aufgaben sind:

• Unterstützung der Ardian Investor Relations Fachleute bei der Entwicklung und Pflege von Kundenbeziehungen und Fundraising Aktivitäten in der Schweiz

• Koordination von Fundraising-Materialien innerhalb der Ardian-Gruppe (z. B. Produkt- / Investmentteams)

• Market Intelligence und Research zur Schweizer Investorenlandschaft

• Organisation und Vorbereitung von Veranstaltungen und anderen PR-Aktivitäten

• Maßgeschneiderte Materialien für überzeugende, qualitativ hochwertige Kundenpräsentationen

• Verwaltungsaufgaben wie Kundendokumentation und Management Reporting

• Eigene Value Add Projekte und Initiativen

Erforderliche Fähigkeiten
Der ideale Kandidat sollte mitbringen:

• Kundenorientierter Ansatz und hoher Qualitätsanspruch

• Keen Interesse an privaten Märkten

• Fähigkeit, überzeugende Inhalte zu erstellen; Datenvisualisierung Fähigkeiten wären ein Plus

• Starke Multitasking- und Organisationsfähigkeiten

• Zuverlässiger Teamplayer mit starken zwischenmenschlichen Kompetenzen

• Gute Kenntnisse von MS-Office-Anwendungen (insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel)

• Ausgezeichnete Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (verbal und schriftlich); Französischkenntnisse sind ein starkes Plus

Profil

• Abschlussjahresstudent oder neuer Absolvent (Bachelor / Master) in Business, Finanzen oder einem verwandten Bereich

• Relevante Arbeits- oder Praktikumserfahrung in der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche, Beratung, Marketing oder einem verwandten Bereich

• Wohnsitz und Erwerbsberechtigung in der Schweiz

Über das Team
Als Intern sind Sie fester Bestandteil des Investor Relations Teams von Ardian in der Schweiz, das für den Aufbau und die Pflege starker, langfristiger Partnerschaften mit Schweizer Investoren verantwortlich ist. Unser Schweizer Team ist Teil des globalen Investor Relations Teams von Ardian mit mehr als 160 Fachleuten. Für weitere Informationen über unser Team und seine Aktivitäten besuchen Sie bitte: https://www.ardian.com/investor-relations

Weitere Angaben
Wettbewerbliche Ausgleichszahlungen
Lunchgutschein

Anwendungsprozess
Über den APPLY-Link auf dieser Seite reichen Sie bitte Ihre Bewerbungsunterlagen in deutscher Sprache ein (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, akademische Unterlagen und relevante Zusatzdokumente wie Zeugnisse, Referenzschreiben usw.), wobei in Ihrem Anschreiben die Praktikumsreferenz ( Ref: IR2027) sowie eine Angabe Ihrer frühesten Verfügbarkeit angegeben werden.

Um Ihre Rekrutierungsaussichten zu verbessern und sich auf mögliche Interviews vorzubereiten, wenden Sie sich bitte an unser Resource Center. Dort erhalten Sie Zugang zu einer breiten Palette von Ratschlägen, Vorbereitungsmaterialien und Testimonials.

Le stagiaire travaillera directement avec les gérants de relations d'Ardiana pour les investisseurs suisses. Les tâches typiques sont les suivantes :

• Soutenir les professionnels des relations avec les investisseurs dans le développement et le maintien des relations avec les clients et des activités de collecte de fonds en Suisse

• Domicile et admissible au travail en Suisse

jobs.description:
The role

Ardian is looking for an intern to join its Secondaries and Primaries investment team based in Zurich. The candidate would be part of the global over 110-member strong Secondaries and Primaries team located in offices in Europe, Asia, and North America. Interns are an integral part of the Secondaries and Primaries team and work together with the investment professionals, allowing interns to gain deep insight into the private equity industry.

The duration of the internship is six months, with a start in January 2027 (please indicate in your application your earliest availability).
Tasks would include:

• Analyzing investment opportunities (primaries and secondaries)

• Financial modelling in Excel to value/monitor portfolio companies

• Monitoring and analyzing private equity portfolios

• Preparing client reports

• Completing other assigned tasks on a wide variety of subjects

Required skills

• Proficient user of MS Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)

• Proficient in German and in English (French is a plus)

• Able to work independently

• Eager to learn quickly and willing to take on multiple tasks

• Be a reliable team player

Profile

• University student or recent graduate (Master or Bachelor level) in Finance, Banking, Business or Economics with strong academic qualifications

• Internship experience in relevant areas (financial services industry, private equity, M&A, consulting, etc.)

• Strong analytical skills

• Keen interest in private markets, with a basic knowledge of private market investments

• Domiciled and eligible to work in Switzerland

Other informations

• Competitive compensation

• Lunch voucher

To enhance your recruitment prospects and prepare for potential interviews, please consult our Resource Center . There, you will gain access to a wide range of advice, preparatory materials, and testimonials.

jobs.description:
Composed of more than 80 professionals, the Fund Finance Secondaries & Primaries team is in charge of financial control, operational management and reporting across Ardian's Secondaries & Primaries platform and Customized Solutions. For Customized Solutions, the Fund Finance team also fulfills investor servicing and is in direct contact with the Investor Relationship Manager and the Front Office to manage the operations of Customized Solutions as a dedicated operational contact.

The role
Part of the global Fund Finance Secondaries & Primaries team, the Zurich team is looking for an Intern to support the Fund Finance activities of Customized Solutions (ACS).

The Intern will support the team in all aspects of its Fund Finance ACS activities, including:

• Preparation of quarterly investor reports

• Support in the preparation of the quarterly valuation committee

• Support in the preparation of the board meeting for Customized Solutions clients

• Responsible for weekly cash controls

• Responsible for the controls, preparation and documentation of the diversification report
This list is not exhaustive and will vary depending on the capabilities of the Intern and the needs of the team.

Required skills

• The candidate should possess a broad set of quantitative, qualitative and interpersonal skills, and be a strong team player

• Intellectual rigour and discipline

• Ability to organise and perform work efficiently

• Basic knowledge of private market investments and general fund performance figures

• Strong analytical skills and competency in Excel, Word and Powerpoint

Profile

• Degree in business administration, finance & accounting or controlling

• Strong commercial understanding of Private Equity

• At least one previous internship in one of the following areas would be beneficial:
• Private Markets Fund Finance

• Audit in a leading audit firm (ideally financial services)

• Comparable experiences in the financial services industry

• Excellent English skills; German level at least B2

• Domiciled and eligible to work in Switzerland

Application process
Please send your application (CV, cover letter and any references) by clicking on APPLY.

To enhance your recruitment prospects and prepare for potential interviews, please consult our Resource Center . There, you will gain access to a wide range of advice, preparatory materials, and testimonials.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Composto da più di 80 professionisti, il team Fund Finance Secondaries & Primaries è responsabile del controllo finanziario, della gestione operativa e del reporting attraverso la piattaforma Ardian's Secondaries & Primaries e soluzioni personalizzate. Per soluzioni personalizzate, il team di Fund Finance soddisfa anche il servizio degli investitori ed è in diretto contatto con il Responsabile Relazioni Investor e con il Front Office per gestire le operazioni di Soluzioni personalizzate come un contatto operativo dedicato.

Il ruolo
Parte del team globale di Finanze e Primari del Fondo, il team di Zurigo sta cercando un Interno per sostenere le attività di Fund Finance di Soluzioni Su misura (ACS).

L'Intern sosterrà il team in tutti gli aspetti delle attività del Fund Finance ACS, tra cui:

• Preparazione delle relazioni trimestrali degli investitori

• Sostegno alla preparazione del comitato trimestrale di valutazione

• Supporto nella preparazione della riunione di bordo per i clienti di soluzioni personalizzate

• Responsabile dei controlli settimanali in contanti

• Responsabile dei controlli, della preparazione e della documentazione della relazione di diversificazione
Questa lista non è esaustiva e varia a seconda delle capacità dell'Intern e delle esigenze del team.

Competenze necessarie

• Il candidato dovrebbe possedere una vasta serie di competenze quantitative, qualitative e interpersonali, ed essere un forte giocatore di squadra
